_comment: Yugen Kagaribi, the lantern fox (SLICE_PLAN 3.2, kit sheet docs/heroes-v2/kits/yugen_kagaribi.txt). The kit fields are the slice fixture's (src/test/resources/heroes/slice/yugen_kagaribi.json); art and animations are source only (HEROES_V2 12.5, 12.6). One body for good (the owner's rule of 2026-11-13, HEROES_V2 3.6): an adult of ordinary size, slim build, drawn at 100%.
name: Yugen Kagaribi
title: the Lantern Fox
description: A soft-spoken fox merchant-lord whose foxfire burns blue and cold.

ultimate.name: Ninefold Lantern
ultimate.line: Nine lanterns, one bill. Shall we settle it?

transition.line: Which of me is lying? All of us, perhaps.
Enough games. Let the lanterns speak.

intro.line: A customer? How delightful. The price today is your patience.

quirks: smiles most when he is lying, and he is always smiling

founding: Sign here, and here. Congratulations: you all work for the Veiled Lantern now.
greeting: Ah, {player}. Buying or selling? With me it is always both.
escape: Mm. A poor bargain. Let us call the account... deferred.
fallen: So the bill comes due after all. How novel.

yug.fv_wind._comment: Foxfire Volley wind-up: the chest turned to his left, the closed fan cocked across before the left shoulder pointing up and back, the left sleeve drawn back low; his tails flare wide and lift (the tell).

yug.fv_fling._comment: Foxfire Volley's release: the fan snapped open and swept out flat to the front right at shoulder height, the chest turning into it, the left arm out for balance; five flames fly.

yug.fv_follow._comment: Foxfire Volley follow-through: the open fan carried on out to his right, the chest turned right, the sleeves trailing.

yug.fc_wind1._comment: Fan Cut wind-up: the fan snapped open and drawn back high beside the right side of his head, edge first, the chest turned right, the left hand up before the chest.

yug.fc_cut1._comment: Fan Cut, the first strike: the open fan slashed down and across to the front left, the chest turning into it, the weight forward.

yug.fc_wind2._comment: Fan Cut, between the strikes: the open fan whipped round to his left at chest height for the backhand, the chest wound to the left.

yug.fc_cut2._comment: Fan Cut, the second strike: a flat backhand sweep out to the front right at chest height (the knockback), the chest turned right behind it, the left arm flung back for balance.

yug.fc_follow._comment: Fan Cut follow-through: the open fan carried on out to his right and tipped up, the chest still turned right.

yug.va_veil._comment: Vanish wind-up: the knees dip and the left sleeve sweeps up before his face, veiling it to the eyes (a sly glance over it), the fan drawn in to the chest.

yug.va_hop._comment: Vanish: the hop back (the server carries him 6 blocks): off the ground with the knees tucked, the body tipped a little forward, the sleeve still before his face.

yug.va_land._comment: Vanish's landing: soft on bent knees, the sleeve swept down and away, the fan out to the side.

yug.mi_hide._comment: Mirage wind-up: the fan opened as a screen beside his face, half of it hidden behind the paper, one narrowed eye over the edge, the left hand at his chest, the lanterns drawn in close and burning bright (the tell).

yug.mi_reveal._comment: Mirage's release: the open fan swept aside low to his right and the left arm opened out to the left, palm up, presenting the two mirages that step out of him; the lanterns flung wide.

yug.mi_pose._comment: Mirage recovery: the fan brought back before his chest, half closed, a smug tilt of the head.

yug.lr_raise._comment: Lantern Ring wind-up: the closed fan raised upright before his face like a prayer stick, eyes shut, the left hand at its foot; the lanterns sink to his hips and spread wide around him (the tell).

yug.lr_snap._comment: Lantern Ring's release: the fan snapped open and swept down and out to his right, pointing at the ground; the ring of lantern fire around him ignites.

yug.lr_hold._comment: Lantern Ring, held: upright and composed inside the ring, the open fan held before his chest and fanning lazily, the left hand tucked behind him.

yug.fr_call._comment: Foxfire Rain wind-up: the closed fan pointed straight up overhead, the left hand raised palm up, the head tipped back; the lanterns climb high over him (the tell).

yug.fr_drop._comment: Foxfire Rain's release: the fan snapped open and swept down to point at the ground ahead, calling the flames down; the lanterns high and wide.

yug.fr_beckon._comment: Foxfire Rain, between the impacts: the open fan lifted a little to beat time again.

yug.ul_open._comment: Ninefold Lantern wind-up: a half step of weight back, the fan opened beside his face as a screen, the left hand raised by it; the lanterns gather behind him and stand up into a wheel.

yug.ul_raise._comment: Ninefold Lantern wind-up: the open fan swept up high at his right, the left arm out and open, the chest lifted; the wheel of lanterns blazes behind him ('Nine lanterns, one bill').

yug.ul_shot_a._comment: Ninefold Lantern, a shot: the open fan flicked forward and a little to his right, edge on, sending one flame from the wheel; the chest turned into it.

yug.ul_shot_b._comment: Ninefold Lantern, the next shot: the fan flicked back across to the front left, the chest turning with it.

yug.ul_close._comment: Ninefold Lantern recovery: the fan snapped shut and lowered before his chest with a small courteous bow ('paid in full'); the wheel lowering and lying back down into his orbit.

yug.p2_laugh._comment: Phase 2: the laugh behind the sleeve, the left hand up before his mouth with the sleeve hanging from it, the head tipped and the eyes closed in delight, the fan held at his chest; his six tails fan out past their place.

yug.p3_flare._comment: Phase 3: the arms flung up and open, the fan open high at his right, the chest lifted and the head up with glowing eyes; the lanterns flare and rise ('Let the lanterns speak').

yug.in_bow._comment: Intro: a slow courteous bow, the closed fan laid flat across his chest, the left hand folded behind his back.

yug.in_rise._comment: Intro: up from the bow with the closed fan touched to his lips, eyes smiling over it.

yug.vi_fan._comment: Victory: fanning himself lazily, the open fan beside his face at shoulder height, the left hand tucked into the right sleeve before his waist.

yug.vi_tap._comment: Victory: the fan snapped shut and tapped into his left palm ('paid in full').

yug.ta_tease._comment: Taunt: the closed fan touched to his lips, the left hand held out palm up at chest height, beckoning with curling fingers ('the price today is your patience').

yug.ls_snap._comment: Last stand: the fan snapped shut and held point down at his right side, the smile gone, the chin lowered.

yug.ls_guard._comment: Last stand: the fan flicked open into a guard before his chest, the left hand raised with two fingers up beside it (a sign), the lanterns drawn in close and blazing; no more games.

yug.es_sleeve._comment: Escape (over the run, upper body): the left sleeve swept up before his face as he turns away, a sidelong glance back over it, the fan tucked to his chest.

yug.pl_sleeve._comment: Sleeve laugh: the left sleeve raised to his mouth, the head tipped, eyes closed.

yug.ps_point._comment: Lantern spin: the closed fan raised before him, its tip drawing a slow circle that the lanterns answer.

yug.pt_glance._comment: Tail-fan flick: a glance back over his left shoulder as his tails flare wide and lift, the fan held at his chest.

yug.p2_laugh2._comment: Phase 2: the laugh held, the six tails settled in their fan.

yug.vi_tap2._comment: Victory: the fan lifted from the palm between the two taps.

yug.p2_fold._comment: Phase 2's start, offsets over the stance: his six tails folded together onto the middle, where his three were.

yug.p3_fold._comment: Phase 3's start, offsets over the stance: the three returning tails folded down and together.

move.foxfire_volley.description: Foxfire Volley (move slot 0, a volley of 5, light: 0.5 / 0.3 / 0.4 s): his tails flare wide and lift (the tell) while the closed fan is cocked across before his left shoulder and the chest turns away (0.22 s), a held beat, then the fan snaps open and sweeps out flat to the front right at shoulder height as five flames fly at 0.40 s (hit, tick 10), carrying on out to his right until 0.65 s (cast: the active part's last tick, tick 15); the fan snaps shut and he is back in his stance by 1.1 s. Upper body, hips and tails.

move.lantern_ring.description: Lantern Ring (move slot 1, a zone of radius 4 round him, area: 1.0 / 3.0 / 0.8 s): he raises the closed fan upright before his face like a prayer stick, eyes shut, while his lanterns sink to his hips and spread wide round him (the tell, 0.45-0.8 s); the fan snaps open and sweeps down and out to his right at 0.90 s (hit, tick 20: the ring of lantern fire ignites), and he stands composed inside it fanning himself while it pulses (to 3.85 s, cast, tick 79); the fan shuts and the lanterns rise back into their orbit by 4.7 s.

move.fan_cut.description: Fan Cut (move slot 2, a combo of 2, light: 0.4 / 0.3 / 0.3 s): the fan snaps open and is drawn back high beside his head (0.18 s), slashed down and across to the front left at 0.30 s (the first strike, tick 8), whipped round to his left and swept flat out to the front right at 0.55 s (the second strike and its knockback, tick 13), carried on out and tipped up, and shut again as he settles by 0.9 s. Upper body and hips.

move.vanish.description: Vanish (move slot 3, on himself, light: 0.4 / 0.1 / 0.3 s): the knees dip and the left sleeve sweeps up before his face, a sly glance over it (0.16 s); the hop back at 0.30 s (hit, tick 8: he turns invisible and the server carries him 6 blocks back), knees tucked under the sleeve, cast at 0.35 s (tick 9), down soft on bent knees at 0.5 s with the sleeve swept away, and back in his stance by 0.7 s.

move.mirage.description: Mirage (move slot 4, two decoys, heavy: 0.8 / 0.2 / 0.8 s): the fan opens beside his face as a screen and only his narrowed eyes show past its edge, the lanterns drawn in close and burning bright, his body wavering side to side like a heat shimmer (the tell, 0.3-0.62 s); the fan sweeps aside low to his right and his left arm opens palm up at 0.70 s (hit, tick 16: the two mirages step out of him), the lanterns flung wide, cast at 0.85 s (tick 19); a smug tilt of the head with the fan back at his chest, and his stance by 1.7 s.

move.foxfire_rain.description: Foxfire Rain (move slot 5, 8 impacts within 5 blocks over 2 s, area: 1.0 / 2.0 / 0.8 s): the closed fan pointed straight up overhead and the left hand raised palm up, his head tipped back, while the lanterns climb high over him (the tell, 0.45-0.8 s); the fan snaps open and sweeps down to point at the ground ahead at 0.90 s (hit, tick 20: the rain begins), then beats time with the falling flames, lifted and dropped every half second, to 2.85 s (cast, tick 59); the fan shuts and the lanterns come down by 3.7 s.

ultimate.description: Ninefold Lantern (the ultimate, a barrage of 9 foxfire 0.2 s apart: 1.6 / 1.8 / 1.5 s): a half step of weight back with the fan opened beside his face, while his three lanterns gather behind him and stand up into a wheel (0.35-0.75 s); the fan swept up high at his right and the left arm opened, the wheel blazing ('Nine lanterns, one bill', 1.2 s); then nine flicks of the open fan, forward right and forward left in turn, one flame each, at 1.50 to 3.10 s (hits, ticks 32 to 64, 4 ticks apart), cast at 3.25 s (tick 67); the fan snapped shut with a small courteous bow while the wheel lies back down into his orbit, and his stance by 4.8 s.

phase.2.description: Phase 2 (inside the 1.2 s transition): his six tails fan out from behind him (they start folded together where his three were and spread past their place, settling) while he laughs behind his left sleeve, eyes closed in delight ('Which of me is lying? All of us, perhaps.').

phase.3.description: Phase 3 (inside the 1.2 s transition): his first three tails come back burning, rising and spreading into the middle of the fan, while he flings his arms up and open with the fan wide, the chest lifted and the eyes glowing, and the lanterns flare and rise ('Enough games. Let the lanterns speak.').

intro.description: Intro (the server holds the intro as long as the clip): a slow courteous bow with the closed fan laid across his chest and the left hand behind his back, eyes shut and smiling; up again with the closed fan touched to his lips, eyes smiling over it ('A customer? How delightful.').

victory.description: Victory: fanning himself lazily with the open fan beside his face, the left hand tucked into his right sleeve, laughing softly with his eyes closed; then the fan snapped shut and tapped twice into his left palm ('Paid in full.').

taunt.description: Taunt: the closed fan touched to his lips, the left hand held out palm up and beckoning with curling fingers, a smug look over the fan ('The price today is your patience').

last_stand.description: Last stand (no action code yet: for the engine side to play when he cannot run, HEROES_V2 6.13): the fan snapped shut and held point down at his side, the smile gone for once; then flicked open into a guard before his chest with two fingers raised beside it, the lanterns drawn in close and blazing: no more games.

escape.description: Escape (no action code yet: for the engine side to play as an escape starts, HEROES_V2 6.13), 0.6 s over the run: 'Mm. A poor bargain.' The left sleeve swept up before his face as he turns away, a sidelong glance back over it with a smirk, then the arms back into the run. The upper body only, over and back into move.run.

personal.1.description: Idle quirk, the sleeve laugh: the left sleeve raised to his mouth, the head tipped and the eyes closed, his shoulders shaking with a soft laugh (the fan stays at his hip).

personal.2.description: Idle quirk, the lantern spin: his right hand raised with one finger up, drawing a slow circle, and the three lanterns answer it, each whirling once round on itself and bobbing (the fan stays at his hip).

personal.3.description: Idle quirk, the tail-fan flick: a smug glance back over his left shoulder as all his tails flare wide and lift, then settle (the fan stays at his hip).

sec.loop.description: The lanterns' orbit on the secondary controller (HeroAnimator plays sec.loop whenever the chain has it): the three lanterns go once round him every 6 s, the orbit wobbling a little like a floating ring. It keys only lantern_orbit's rotation, so a move may still move, tilt and widen the ring (lantern_ring) and turn or scale a lantern (fine_lantern_N).
